quality.basis: 崩溃差分：exploit.c 改为读 PoV，用 cj5_parse 切分，按 ASan 报告判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/open62541/vulnerability_WF_RAG_3/string.json; adapted: the JSON text of exploit.c's hand-built token, "\%p" (5 bytes); cj5_parse yields exactly the exploit's token (start 1, end 3), and the output buffer is malloc'd with the token length + 1 bytes as open62541's JSON decoder does, instead of the exploit's 64-byte stack buffer)

ground_truth.how_found: c5_specs.json: newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/open62541/vulnerability_WF_RAG_3/string.json; adapted: the JSON text of exploit.c's hand-built token, "\%p" (5 bytes); cj5_parse yields exactly the exploit's token (start 1, end 3), and the output buffer is malloc'd with the token length + 1 bytes as open62541's JSON decoder does, instead of the exploit's 64-byte stack buffer

category5.design: open62541's build does not complete in its image (no fuzzers), but cj5 is self-contained, so the driver compiles the build's deps/cj5.c, parse_num.c and utf8.c (no project build) and, adapted from exploit.c, tokenizes the PoV with cj5_parse and decodes every string token with cj5_get_str into a buffer sized as the JSON decoder sizes it; the vulnerable snprintf expansion writes past it and ASan reports it. '-include stdio.h' is needed because the injected code calls snprintf without including stdio.h (an error for modern compilers).
